claims.claim_ar: جعل «نِعْمَتِي» محور العبارة (المعطوف عليه) لبيان تفضيل الله وإتمام نعمته على المُخاطَبِين؛ أي نصب لفظ الفضل على لفظ النعمة كمركز للدلالة على إرادة الإتمام.
claims.claim_en: The phrase «نِعْمَتِي» is placed as the focal (the noun to which the clause is apposed) to indicate God's favour and the completion of His blessing; the verb of preferring is syntactically tied to 'nî'matī' to express the intent to complete the favour.
claims.needs_review_reason: Mapping the commentator's syntactic note to a specific maʿnī subdevice (here rendered as 'ijab_inshāʾ' — expression of divine intent/commitment) is interpretive; original chunks are from al-Kashshaf (Zamakhshari) rather than the named balagha authors, so cross-check with Jurjani/Sakkaki/Baqillani/Suyuti sources is recommended.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Emphasizes divine favour as an assured, completed gift and links the command to a theological promise, strengthening motivation toward guidance.

warnings: Source chunks provided are from Zamakhshari (al-Kashshaf); requested classical balagha authors (al-Jurjani, al-Sakkaki, al-Baqillani, al-Suyuti, tafsir balagha) are not present in the input. Claims are therefore drawn only from the available chunks.

Only substrings actually present in the supplied chunks were used for source_quote_ar. Many obvious rhetorical features of the verse (repetition, parallelism, antithesis) could not be claimed because their exact word-strings did not appear verbatim in the provided chunks.
Some device classification (e.g., labeling the use of «نِعْمَتِي» as 'ijab_inshaa') is interpretive; please review against the target balagha taxonomy and the primary authors' texts for confirmation.
